questions.q: Explain how a bank that holds sound loans could still fail.

ideas.label: Savers lose confidence and withdraw, in a bank run
Its loans are long term, so it lacks the cash or liquidity to pay

questions.model: If savers lose confidence and withdraw, the bank faces a run. Its loans are long term and tied up, so it lacks the cash to pay, even if the loans are sound.
questions.why: Sound isn't the same as liquid.

tests.answer: Savers lose confidence and withdraw, but the loans are long term so it lacks the cash.
